tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ yang dag thugs kyi sgrub pa bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bcom ldan dpal chen badz+ra he ru ka: thugs kyi lha mchog shin tu gsal zhing gnyan: bdag nyid sgrub pa mthar phyin rnal 'byor pa: bdag 'dra gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying po yis: thugs kyi gsang sgrub yang dag zab tu dril: de nyid gnad kyi sgrub pa 'di yin te: dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la 'dug: skyabs sems tshad med pa bzhi sngon song nas: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: dmigs med ngang nas bskyed pa'i sngags brjod pas: bdag nyid dpal chen badz+ra he ru ka: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing rngam zhing brjid: spyan dgu zhal bsgrad mche gtsigs rigs lngas brgyan: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ḍā ma ru: g.yon gsum bhan+dha thod khrag rgyu zhags 'dzin: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs par gsol: kro tī shwa rī yum mchog sku la 'khril: rgyan dang sku mdog yab 'dra gri thod 'khyud: de yi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mthing nag rdo rje dang: bhan+dha bsnams pa tshon gang bsgom par bya: de yi thugs kar tsit+ta rin chen zur brgyad pa: de dbus rdo rje nas tsam gsal bar bsgom: rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma'i dal nyid la: hūm̐ yig mthing nag spu yis bris pa tsam: phyi rim tsit+ta rin chen zur brgyad la: ru lu 'bru brgyad chos 'khor dag tu bsam: de nyid gsal bar brtan par gyur pa dang: ru lu'i bsnyen pa gsal la dag pa bcas: grags stong brag ca lta bur bzlas pa las: bskyed rim gsal ba'i ngang nas rang nyid yi dam lha: thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' nyid la thim: ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje de nyid kyang: hūm̐ la thim ste hūm̐ nyid gyen rdzogs su: mas nas rim bzhin thig le nyid la thim: thig le skye med chos skur rgyas gdab ste: de nyid ngang nas sngags sgra snying po dzap: chos nyid stong pa'i rang sgra dag tu bzla:

ma bcos sems nyid dag pa'i klongs yangs nas: 'dzin med stong pa'i rang sgra chu rgyun ltar: ma bcos ngang nas gsal dag bzlas pa yis: dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi thugs sgrub cing: bla med don gyi sgrub pa 'dis 'grub bo: dang po snang stong lha bskyed chad mtha' bsal: rdzogs rim chos skur bsdus pas rtag mtha' bsal: ma 'gags sngags sgra bzlas pas chad mtha' bsal: sngags sgra stong par shes pas rtag mtha' bsal: ma bcos gsal stong ngang du bzhag pa'i tshe: gnyis ka mtha' las 'das te ngo mtshar che: rjes spyod smon lam gdab cing dge ba bsngo: snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i nga rgyal gyis: sgo gsum dge sogs spyod lam 'jug par bya: skal ldan skyes bu 'di la sus 'bad pa: dngos grub lo zla tsam gyis 'thob par 'gyur: grangs kyi bsnyen pa bdun 'bum nyi khris 'grub: gsang sngags 'di la rnal 'byor sus brtson pa: khyad par rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig dang: sdom gsum tshul khrims nyams sogs ma lus pa: thams cad 'di yis sor chud nyams chag skong: dngos grub rnam gnyis ye nas nges thob cing: khyad par nyams chag skong ba'i mthar thug go: rig 'dzin tshe yi mchog kyang 'dis 'grub bo: ci phyir zhe na gsang ba'i thugs sgrub yin: zab mo thugs kyi sgrub pa bla med 'di: yang dag thugs kyi sgrub pa phyogs gcig dril: zab don nyung dril nyams su blang bar bde: 'di las zab pa'i thugs sgrub mthar thug pa: 'jig rten 'di na 'byung ba ga la srid: kye: sngon nas bsod nams bsags pa'i las 'phro yis: 'di dang 'phrad par gyur pa ma lags pa: btsal bas 'jig rten 'di nas ga la rnyed: de phyir 'di la brtson pa rtag tu skyed: dngos grub gzhan las myur ram bsgrubs la ltos: zhal mjal lung ston thugs brgyud byin gyis rlobs: nyi shar brag ri 'dzeg cing gcer bur bud: khrus byed dar chen phyar ram dung chen 'bud: mi mang khrom chen 'du dang dge la bskul:

de sogs rtags kyi rim pa bsam mi khyab: bdag 'dra nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs bcud 'di: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rat+na gling pas bsam yas ar+ya pa lo'i gling nas gdan drangs pa'o// shog ser ngos las bsam gtan gling du bdag 'dra sangs rgyas sprang ban rin chen gyis/ blo la snang bas zhus pa lags// //
